description: This file defines the 'GoalType' enum, provides functions to convert between string representations and enum values, and defines the 'Goal' class with JSON serialization/deserialization methods for representing fitness goals.

classes.name: Goal
classes.description: Represents a fitness goal with properties such as id, type, target value, and current progress. Includes methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: goalTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding GoalType enum value, with default fallback to stepsDaily.

methods.name: goalTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a GoalType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: Goal.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Goal instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: Goal.toJson
methods.description: Converts a Goal instance to a JSON map.
